We are very sorry to hear about your experience and that you felt there was a lack of concern during your call. 
In line with guidance from NHS England, GP practices have been asked to implement online triage systems such as SystmConnect to help manage patient requests safely and efficiently.
Most SystmConnect requests are reviewed and responded to on the same day, often within 1–2 hours. This system allows the practice team to assess each request and ensure patients are directed to the most appropriate care in a timely manner.
If a patient is unable to complete the online form or requires assistance, our team is happy to help. The form can be completed on the patient’s behalf either in person at the practice or over the phone.
If you would like to discuss this further please contact the surgery on 0191 2620444 and ask to speak to Sharon Graham our Patient Manager.
